source_issue.title: PLIP: Start separating Blicca (Classic UI) code from the core

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the gradual separation of the Classic UI code from the core of Plone, specifically by moving templates and view logic into the `plone.app.layout` package. This is aimed at making the code cleaner and easier to maintain while optimizing it for users who utilize the Volto frontend.

## What needs to be done
Contributors should help with moving specific Classic UI components into the new `plone.app.layout` package. The goal is to have `plone.classicui` focus on being a lightweight distribution, while ensuring compatibility for existing users. Discussions are ongoing regarding the exact structure and components to be moved.

## Helpful background
The need for this change stems from a desire to reduce code duplication and size. Currently, there is some uncertainty about which templates will exactly be moved and how to proceed to maintain compatibility with future versions of Plone (like Plone 7). 

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the recent discussions in this issue and related PLIPs.
2. Review the existing Classic UI templates to understand which ones might be applicable for transfer.
3. Participate in discussions about how best to implement this transition, especially regarding backward compatibility.
4. Consider helping by drafting proposals for specific packages or templates to be moved.
5. Be prepared for testing and reviewing any changes made as part of this issue’s progress.
```
